In the center foreground, a young girl in a yellow sundress points excitedly at a large pile of pumpkins. Beside her, an old man in a straw hat looks at the pumpkins with a gentle smile. A brown dog runs past them, its tongue lolling out happily. To the right, a woman in a green apron hands a basket of apples to a boy in denim overalls. The boy reaches out eagerly to take the basket from her. Behind them, a white horse stands calmly tied to a fence post, chewing on hay.
